## Introduction

Reproduction of BTC-S&P500 correlation analysis using GARCH model family
(GARCH, EGARCH, GJR-GARCH, APARCH) and DCC-GARCH for time-varying correlation.
Extended with Gold, ETH, VIX, NASDAQ.

## Data

Daily log-returns reproduced from the original Kaggle dataset (BTC, S&P 500).
